name: ReasoningBank
what_evolved: Context记忆与提示 (agent memory / reasoning-strategy bank; no weight updates)
skill_as_artifact: Yes - structured natural-language memory items, each with Title / Description / Content (distilled reasoning steps, decision rationales, operational insights)
skill_encoding: 自然语言 (structured NL memories; not code/embeddings)
skill_granularity: 策略规则 / 见解 (generalizable reasoning strategies, preventative lessons, high-level workflow insights)
how_method: rollout_optimization (non-gradient memory distillation from trajectories) + reward-based via LLM-as-judge self-assessment; MaTTS adds parallel/sequential test-time scaling
learning_signal_source: 成败轨迹 (both successful AND failed self-judged experiences) + LLM-as-judge self-reflection; contrastive signals across parallel rollouts
learning_paradigm: online; off-policy (memory built from past trajectories, retrieved for new tasks)
when_evolve: inter-test-time (continuous retrieval-extraction-consolidation loop across task stream) + intra-test-time (MaTTS scaling within a task)
trigger: 事件触发 (each task completion triggers LLM-judge assessment + memory extraction/append)
library_structure: 扁平 (flat append-only bank; consolidation left to future work)
retrieval_method: 语义相似度 (relevant memories retrieved into context before action)
validation: LLM-judge (LLM-as-a-judge self-assesses trajectory as success/failure before extraction; reported robust to judgment noise)
error_correction: self-revision (sequential scaling iteratively refines reasoning; failed experiences distilled into preventative lessons/strategic guardrails)
where_deploy: general (web browsing + software engineering agent tasks)
metrics: success_rate + cost/efficiency (task steps); generalization across persistent task streams
key_results: +8.3% success on WebArena and +4.6% on SWE-Bench-Verified vs memory-free ReAct; ~3 fewer execution steps/task on SWE-Bench; outperforms Synapse (trajectory) and AWM (workflow) memory; MaTTS (k=5 parallel) adds further ~+3% on WebArena; emergent evolution of simple checklists into compositional preventative strategies
limitations: scalability (append-only consolidation, no dedup/merging); relies on imperfect self-judgment (though robust to noise); memory quality depends on exploration diversity; transferability across very different domains [uncertain]
